title: Federal Reserve expected to cut interest rates amid Trump pressure – live updates
summary: Decision due amid concerns about political influence at independent central bank – with Trump aide sworn in as governor and Lisa Cook fighting removal The US Federal Reserve is expected to announce the first interest rate cut since December as a two-day policy meeting nears its end. The Fed started the meeting on Tuesday, hours after Donald Trump’s new appointee narrowly won confirmation to join the central bank – while Fed governor Lisa Cook continues to fight her removal by the president.
